name: Jolpan
ingredients: Jolpan rice variants (Bora Saul, Komal Saul, or Chira)
instructions: 1. Soak Komal Saul or Chira (flattened rice) in water for a few minutes until soft and hydrated.
2. Drain the excess water thoroughly from the rice.
3. Place the prepared rice in a bowl and pour fresh, thick curd over it.
4. Add grated or liquid jaggery according to your preference for sweetness.
5. Mix gently and serve alongside slices of ripe banana or traditional Pitha.
description: Jolpan is a quintessential Assamese snack or breakfast, deeply rooted in the agrarian culture of the state. It is commonly served during Bihu festivals and as a welcoming meal for guests, reflecting the simplicity and richness of local, seasonal ingredients.
